Leaf display views are deliberately omitted — a section that only renders and feeds nothing would add a column of blanks. Section names are clickable and open the section directly.
🎯 Why it is worth consulting before editing

AgentCase's inputs are heavily coupled: 🎯 Scope alone drives the glass ceiling, automation potential, effort weights, supervision averages, the Gantt layout and the team decomposition. Editing without knowing the fan-out is how people end up surprised by a moved headline. This matrix is the map of that coupling.

Nothing on this page is hardcoded. Nodes, rows, columns and graph lanes are derived from the section catalogue and its menu groups, so a section added, renamed, moved between groups or deleted is reflected here with no code change. The links themselves are
it drives — and live in one editable registry (

This is a curated documentation view of the dependency structure. The live wiring that actually invalidates and recomputes is the DEP graph inside the engine — this page documents it for humans; it does not drive it.
